description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.

The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How do I ensure idempotence ](~~25693~~).
The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster.

description.zh: 修改后的专属块存储集群的名称。
description.en: The new name of the dedicated block storage cluster.
The new description of dedicated block storage cluster.

description.zh: 专属块存储集群所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改专属块存储集群属性

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
您可以修改专属块存储集群的名称、描述信息等信息。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to modify the information of a dedicated block storage cluster. The information includes the name and description of the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs modify-dedicated-block-storage-cluster-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dbsc-id dbsc-cn-od43bf0000 --dbsc-name my-test-dbsc --description test --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
